name: code-map
description: Token-efficient, drift-resistant code reads. grep finds, code-map read reads.

interface.shortDescription: grep finds, code-map read reads — token-efficient, drift-resistant reads.
interface.longDescription: code-map ships a retrieval-routing skill: read known symbols with code-map read (batch independent refs in one call), use grep only to discover, and never double-fetch (grep to find AND read on top). Reading known symbols is the win; the routing keeps discovery a win too.
defaultPrompt: Refresh my working set after these edits.
